name: National MILO Marathon 2026 – Passi Iloilo Leg
short_description: National MILO Marathon 2026 – Passi Iloilo Leg is on Sunday 25 October 2026 in Passi City, Iloilo, over 3 km, 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: The Passi Iloilo leg is one of the regional qualifying races of the 2026 National MILO Marathon, the series' 50th-anniversary "Golden Run", organised by RUNRIO Inc. It offers a 21K half marathon plus 10K, 5K and 3K races. Qualifying times set in the 21K earn a place in the 42.195 km race at the National Finals in Clark.

faqs.question: What are the cut-off times for the National MILO Marathon 2026 Passi Iloilo Leg?
faqs.answer: The 21K half marathon has a cut-off of 2 hours 30 minutes after the official start, and 21K runners must reach 10 km within 1 hour 30 minutes. The 10K cut-off is 2 hours, and the 5K and 3K cut-offs are 1 hour each.

faqs.question: Who can run the 21K at the National MILO Marathon 2026 Passi Iloilo Leg?
faqs.answer: Half marathon runners must be 18 or older on race day and must bring a Fit-To-Run medical certificate signed by a licensed physician within two months before the race. The standard 21K entry fee is PHP 1,799.
